boundary_evidence.start: SetApplBase starts at $40FE76. Its call to IAZ and direct call to ZoneAdjustEnd identify the first released routine.
boundary_evidence.end: DoCompact ends with RTS at $41045C. DerefHandle begins the internal module at $41045E.

edits.description: Restored the complete contiguous 24-bit implementation. Retained the released header, applicable history, routine contracts, symbolic operands, and matching instruction comments. The historical header describes a later source file; it does not date this reconstruction.

Matched instructions within corresponding released 24-bit routines using resolved equates and operand values. The ROM determines branch targets, widths, direct calls, and instruction encodings. A recorded source operation may have a different encoding in the later source. Omitted comments about removed patches and dispatch vectors.

Replaced build includes and address-mode dispatch with the required released equates and explicit external ROM addresses. Expanded GetZ and SetZ as their MOVE instructions. Declared A-line traps with OPWORD. Preserved PC addressing and the ROM instruction widths.

Restored SetApplBase and IAZ before later alignment and cache patches. IAZ takes ApplLimit and HiHeapMark from ToMaxLimit D2, places the application zone after the system zone, initializes resources, and calls InitZone.

Restored InitApplZone notification, window, menu, font, event, and volume-flush state. The routine calls IAZ and InitAllPacks and records noErr. Restored the 52-byte InitZone header and 12-byte trailer.

Restored direct public entry calls, shared error exits, RecoverHandle behavior, and the HStdEntry helper. StackSpace returns SP + 24 minus bkLim(ApplZone). Later memory-mode dispatch and system-heap growth patches are absent.

Restored MoveHHi and its FindRgnTop, FillStkBuf, and DoCompact helpers. The ROM permits the original heaps, reserves 1,024 bytes below SP, and uses an 18-byte local frame. It predates the saved-TheZone field added in January 1986.

Restored StkSlop from 3,072 to 1,024 and MyStkBuf24 and LclVarSize24 from 22 to 18. Other emitted equates retain their released values. The source retains historical comments but marks the restored frame and stack reserve.
